notes.title: Lasso, Logic Puzzles and Unruly Piggies in the Wild West!
notes.content:
Howdy Cowboys and Cowgirls! 🤠🐎 Ready to rope in some chaos? 


Hogtie will throw some real challenges your way – sharp logic and smart thinking will be key to beat them!

As Ted, a Wild West pro with a trusty lasso, you’ll need to catch and drag all those unruly runaway pigs to the right spots.

Forget classic Sokoban mechanics – no pushing here! Instead quarrel with a twisty, curly (like a pig’s tail!) version of puzzle-solving.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/f427ebf90cb31cdcc21aa416932ddc4a08a05d79.jpg"]

Explore all kinds of wild biomes – from 🏜️ sandy deserts and 🗻 frosty peaks to even ☄️ outer space. Stay sharp though – who said that while roaming through the Wild West you can't accidentally land in space?


The puzzles get tougher as you go. Want to master every board? For perfectionists, there is a limited number of moves to make on each board. Or just take it easy and enjoy the lighthearted fun of chasing pigs with Cowboy Ted.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/d438c812306d6d75a41aae714034be9b2cf775a8.jpg"]

But even going on such a tough mission, you just can't forget about the good style, and the character personalization will provide just that! Adjust the appearance of Ted, turning 🤠 the cowboy into a stylish gentleman, and his fearless steed into… a pink unicorn! 🦄

So grab your cowboy hat, pick up your lasso, and wrangle up a whole mess of unruly piglets!  🐖🐖🐷

notes.title: Devlog 4 – Crafting the Look and Feel of Hogtie
notes.content:
Yeehaw, art cowboys!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/eea060439ab739dc2dff86c64057dcfcd1f20da9.png"]

Today we’re pulling back the curtain on the world of Hogtie – from the cartoony visuals to the customizable cowboy gear, and how it all ties into the game’s feel.

The world of Hogtie is colorful, charming, and just a little bit silly – and that’s exactly how we wanted it. From the very start, we aimed for an art style that feels fun-first. That’s why we built our own cartoon shader and custom visual effects for liquids and rope physics.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/1bebd371fa619e00c929abdc37b102dcbf45136d.jpg"]

The wild west usually comes with grit and dust. We gave it bright skies, cute pigs, and charming animations. We wanted players to feel relaxed while playing – even when the puzzles get tough. The tone is light, approachable, and filled with personality. Our horse winks. Our pigs react when you lasso them. And our cowboy? Fully customizable.

Yes, you can dress Ted up however you like. From classic cowboy to flamboyant leather daddy, Hogtie isn’t afraid to be a little weird and a lot of fun. And don’t worry – everything you interact with follows strict visual clarity rules: silhouettes are clean, colors are purposeful, and every interaction is animated to communicate feedback.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/2741d793c5f7a6666194938524dabbe5633673a1.jpg"]

We made this world to be inviting. We hope you’ll love hanging out in it as much as we loved creating it!

notes.title: Devlog 3 – Meet the Team Behind Hogtie
notes.content:
Howdy from the dusty trails of development!


In this devlog, we’ll introduce the crew at Alacrity Studios—the small but mighty team behind Hogtie, and share what it took to bring our first title to life.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/eea060439ab739dc2dff86c64057dcfcd1f20da9.png"]

We’re Alacrity Studios, a small, newly founded studio from a group of university friends and game jam regulars. Here's the team:

Orhan Yavuz Erhan – 3D/2D Artist, Game Designer

Linn Jupiter – Project Manager, Marketing

Burak Akdere – Developer

Alina Kılınçarslan – Developer

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/46426d6be43c75260550e01f494a344ac7ab218e.jpg"]

We met at university (two of us even graduated top of our class!) and previously worked together in another studio. That chemistry helped us hit the ground running. Hogtie actually started as a game jam project that won first place out of 44 entries, and we were told: “You need to make this a real game.” So… we did.

That’s not to say it’s been smooth sailing. Setting up our first Steam page and development accounts was new territory. And mid-way through production, Discord got banned in our country. That slowed us down more than we expected, since we worked remotely. But we adapted, switched platforms, and kept moving forward.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/6f863bc7feb430a2869b6c8ff36eca62c5d9bc0e.jpg"]

We may be a young studio, but Hogtie is built with the same spirit that got us through that jam: scrappy, creative, and determined!

notes.title: Devlog 2 – Designing the Puzzles of Hogtie
notes.content:
Hey there, lasso lovers and logic cowboys!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/eea060439ab739dc2dff86c64057dcfcd1f20da9.png"]

Today we’re taking you behind the scenes to show how we built Hogtie’s tricky puzzles, biomes, and the balance between fun and frustration.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/f1c30c83fdc2ef4f9352471cdf03dc6805fef653.jpg"]

When we sat down to design Hogtie’s levels, one thing was clear: we didn’t just want puzzles that are "solvable"– we wanted puzzles that are satisfying to master.

Enter our three-star step system. You can always complete a level in as many moves as you like, but earning all three stars? That’s the real challenge. Early levels gently introduce mechanics, letting you experiment. And soon enough, you're juggling ropes, pigs, switches, fences, and ice tiles in increasingly intricate ways.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/0f042388e51bced76348543519b043d3fe7c44ed.jpg"]

We also divided the game into biomes. Why? In a lot of puzzle games, difficulty just ramps and ramps until you hit a wall. We didn’t want that. Biomes give players a soft reset: fresh tiles, new visuals, and a break from previous mechanics. One biome introduces Thin Ice tiles that break after two steps. Another introduces Air tiles, letting pigs literally fly – adding a vertical layer to your strategies. Each biome is designed to feel like a breath of fresh (wild west) air.

Our goal is always clear: make it feel like play, not punishment.

notes.title: Devlog 1 – Why Sokoban with a Lasso? – The Birth of Hogtie
notes.content:
Howdy puzzle wranglers!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/eea060439ab739dc2dff86c64057dcfcd1f20da9.png"]

Saddle up, because today we’re diving into the origins of Hogtie and how a single spark of inspiration turned into a wild west puzzle adventure with a twist.



When we first came up with Hogtie, it was during a local game jam. The theme? "Knots." That single word sparked something strange and exciting. We thought about ropes, tension, and control – and quickly, the image of a cowboy wrangling barrels instead of cattle came to life. But instead of making a traditional wrangling game, we wanted to mix it with something we loved and knew well: Sokoban.


But Hogtie doesn’t just reskin Sokoban. It reinvents it.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/de7bfdb168a0e8f3771e3d92fa47427fdc38035a.jpg"]

The lasso changes everything. Instead of rigid step-by-step puzzles where you push objects, you're now pulling from a distance, binding objects, reeling them in, and solving puzzles in a much more fluid and creative way. The result is what we call "reverse Sokoban." You can’t push anything in Hogtie – only pull. And trust us, that one difference turns the whole genre on its head.



Some puzzles in Hogtie couldn’t exist without the lasso. Take level 1-23: you’re asked to break and rebind the lasso mid-puzzle. Or 1-47, where you guide your pig friend across acid tiles by lassoing fences across water. Classic Sokoban simply can’t handle those ideas. We’re excited to show how one small mechanic–just a lasso – can completely reshape how you think.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/d6c74ffd944bb1dd94ee9b06a1f45950b3c773c8.jpg"]

notes.title: 🤠 Hogtie Rides into Steam's Sokoban Fest!
notes.content:
Howdy, puzzle wranglers! 

We're thrilled to announce that Hogtie is joining the lineup for Steam's Sokoban Fest, running until April 28th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089358/147818779b627b3d0c02b6589898e492dcf2eb8e.png
Our demo has been recently updated and is available for download and play as we speak 🎮

Here are the changes we've mentioned before:

 You can now unlock cosmetics and customize your look. Want to run puzzles in a top hat and boots? Go wild!

 We’ve also balanced a bunch of levels and added brand-new ones, so whether you're just starting out or already lasso-deep, there’s something fresh to test your puzzle skills. 🧪🧩

 Our tutorials now feature video explanations, making it easier than ever to pick up the ropes (literally). 🤠📚

 And of course - bug fixes and quality-of-life updates to make everything smoother than a buttered-up bread loaf. 🥐🐛


Hope you all enjoy the lovely Sokoban Fest!

🐖 Pigs out! 🐷
